data.title: 因幡巡 · 存档点旁的攻略本
data.description: 放学后的社团室只剩窗边亮着。巡把游戏机放在腿上，指着攻略本里一条绕远的路线，认真问你要不要先去捡那只宝箱。
data.promptProse: Meguru sits by the clubroom window in her pink cardigan and yellow scarf. A handheld console rests on her lap as she points to a route in an open guidebook on the desk, looking toward the viewer for an opinion. Late afternoon window light falls across the pages.
data.animaCaption: Her console rests on her lap while one finger stays on the guidebook route.
data.action: 指着攻略本上的路线征询意见
